title: QR Code Data Schema
description: Schema for a list of QR code generation data objects

url.description: The URL to encode in the QR code.

title.description: The title to display below the QR code.

logo_name.description: Optional: The filename of the logo to embed. Must be one of the allowed logo files.

filename.description: The output filename for the generated QR code image (must end with .png).
